title: A small model can be taught by a big one's hesitations
body: Knowledge distillation trains a compact student on a teacher's soft probabilities, not just correct answers; the teacher's near-misses (this 2 is somewhat 7-like) carry the dark knowledge that speeds learning. Hinton, Vinyals and Dean's 2015 paper made model compression a teaching problem. The student often nearly matches a teacher many times its size.
